title: Commercial Building Maintenance and Everyday Repairs
heroCopy: We inspect doors that won’t latch, damaged plasterboard, stained ceilings and loose joinery. We itemise repairs and replacements by area and coordinate the work through to handover.

problems.label: Doors that stick or have loose hardware

solution.heading: Door and Hardware Repairs
solution.inspection: We check the gap between leaf and frame, how the door closer operates, and wear on the hinges and strike plate.
solution.method: We assess what can be realigned or resecured and replace worn parts such as the closer or hinges where needed.
solution.check: We check that the door swings freely and latches, then record the hardware we adjusted or replaced.

solution.heading: Wall Damage and Joint Repairs
solution.inspection: We distinguish surface impact and cracked joints from damage to the plasterboard core, fixings or substrate.
solution.method: We set the scope for patching, local re-sheeting and joint repairs according to the damage, and itemise the finish reinstatement.
solution.check: We check surface levelness, sealing and surrounding protection, recording completed areas.

solution.heading: Ceiling Stain and Panel Repairs
solution.inspection: We trace the extent of staining and damp lining and check for possible sources in roofing, plumbing and air conditioning drainage.
solution.method: We coordinate the leak repair first, then scope ceiling panel replacement and finish reinstatement around the condition of the lining and supports.
solution.check: We verify panel installation, joints and surrounding finishes, and organise before‑and‑after photos.

solution.heading: Fixed Cabinet and Trim Repairs
solution.inspection: We check cabinet doors, drawers, benchtop edges and fixings to distinguish worn hardware from loose joinery.
solution.method: We replace damaged hinges or fixings, repair local benchtop or trim damage and scope the finish to suit the existing joinery.
solution.check: We examine cabinet doors, drawers and fixed components for use, confirming the scope of work.

workflow.body: We assess damage, dimensions and access conditions.

workflow.title: Agree on the scope
workflow.body: We itemise patching, component replacement and finish reinstatement by room.

workflow.title: Carry out the work in stages
workflow.body: We schedule protection, repairs and finishing by work zone around site access and trading hours.

workflow.title: Check the work and hand over
workflow.body: We check that the repaired area works as intended and note anything that needs follow-up.

faq.question: Can you take care of several repairs in one visit?
faq.answer: Yes. We combine items such as door hardware, plasterboard and fixed joinery in one scope, itemise the quote by area and coordinate site access for the trades.

faq.question: When do you patch damage, and when do you replace the part?
faq.answer: We assess the board core, fixings and substrate before itemising patching, partial re-sheeting or hardware replacement. For repainting, we also check existing paint adhesion and signs of damp.

faq.question: If the ceiling shows water marks, should we fix leaks first?
faq.answer: We separate the roof, plumbing or HVAC leak work from ceiling reinstatement, schedule the jobs in order and hand over a record of the areas restored.

faq.question: Can you schedule repairs around our business hours?
faq.answer: We plan the work around your operating hours and access routes, and explain which areas we need to access at each stage.

title: Roofing, Waterproofing & Building Repairs
heroCopy: We investigate commercial roof leaks, overflowing gutters and failed waterproofing. We trace water ingress back to roof joints, flashings and drainage, then itemise clearing, local repairs and replacement.

solution.heading: Roof Leak & Flashing Repair
solution.inspection: We compare staining during and after rain and trace potential entry points around seams, rooftop penetrations and adjoining gutters.
solution.method: We itemise local repairs or replacement of roof sheeting, flashings and waterproofing junctions once we identify the source.
solution.check: We check connections and drainage, record treated areas and any follow‑up observations.

problems.label: Water pooling or overflowing in a box gutter

solution.heading: Box gutter and downpipe maintenance
solution.inspection: We check box gutter ponding marks, joint corrosion, rainheads, overflow outlets and downpipe entries to distinguish blockages from damaged components.
solution.method: We list debris clearing, local joint repairs and gutter or downpipe replacement separately, based on what we find.
solution.check: We recheck the rainheads, outlets and connections we worked on and provide location photos.

solution.heading: Roof seam and flashing repairs
solution.inspection: We check the upslope side of roof penetrations, equipment flashings, parapet cappings and sheet laps for loose or damaged components.
solution.method: We identify roof sheets and flashings that can stay and specify the joints, fixings and junctions that need repair.
solution.check: We recheck connections and seals, then record where we worked and anything that needs follow-up.

solution.heading: Waterproofing membrane and substrate repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect blistering, cracks, corners and movement joints and assess membrane adhesion and the adjoining substrate.
solution.method: We identify affected areas, treat the substrate and complete the corresponding waterproofing layer and seal repairs.
solution.check: We check the repairs against the agreed scope and record the materials and work completed.

items.body: We inspect surface damage, corners and substrate condition.

workflow.body: We inspect treated areas and provide before/after photos.

faq.question: Do I need to replace the entire roof for leak repairs?
faq.answer: We locate the entry point and extent of damage, then itemise which joints or flashings can be repaired and which roof components need replacing.

faq.question: Can you repair a box gutter and its downpipes together?
faq.answer: Yes. We inspect box gutters, rainheads, overflow outlets and downpipes together. If overflow returns after clearing, we check ponding, joints and the outlet path.

faq.question: Can you repair the damaged ceiling as well as the roof?
faq.answer: We can coordinate roof repairs and ceiling reinstatement in the same job, with the ceiling work scheduled after we address the source of the leak.

faq.question: How do you quote on a roof leak?
faq.answer: We scope the inspection around roof type, working height, access and where the water appears. We then itemise gutter clearing, flashing repair or component replacement.

title: Commercial Electrical & Lighting
heroCopy: We investigate electrical faults and repair lighting in shops, offices and warehouses. We identify which fittings or circuits are affected before arranging repairs or upgrades.

solution.heading: Lighting Faults & Fixture Updates
solution.inspection: We check when the flicker occurs, how the lights respond to dimming, and whether nearby fittings are affected, then inspect the drivers, controls and relevant circuits.
solution.method: We assess whether the existing fittings can stay and itemise work on drivers, dimming controls or complete fittings.
solution.check: We test lighting and control functions, recording completed work.

solution.heading: Circuit & Power Issue Resolution
solution.inspection: We review when the circuit trips, what equipment is operating and which area loses power, then arrange checks on the relevant circuits and connections.
solution.method: We address faulty components or connections per the inspection, and identify items that need updating.
solution.check: We arrange for a licensed electrician to recheck the circuits and equipment covered by the job and record the repairs and results.

problems.label: Damaged switches or too few power points

solution.heading: Switch and power point repairs and upgrades
solution.inspection: We confirm the affected power points and switches against the equipment in use and the circuits serving them.
solution.method: We repair or replace damaged points and, within the confirmed scope, add new or relocate existing ones.
solution.check: We test the affected fittings and equipment and check the installation against the work records.

problems.label: Insufficient lighting in corridors or work areas

solution.heading: Corridor & Work Area Lighting Updates
solution.inspection: We review warehouse clearance, racking, work areas and existing fittings before scoping high-bay and aisle lighting.
solution.method: We update fixtures or adjust layouts within the confirmed scope, aligning lighting with actual use areas.
solution.check: We assess lighting and control performance, recording fixture positions and completed items.

Switching between office, corridor and warehouse tags lights up only the corresponding area with a fluorescent yellow strip; a narrow orange sidebar on the right shows the key points for that area. items.body: We coordinate lighting updates with workstations, reception areas and existing fixture placements.

items.body: We inspect passage routes, control methods and lighting zones.

items.title: Warehouses & Work Zones
items.body: We determine fixture placement based on mounting height, shelving and work positions.

workflow.body: We record the fault and how the affected area is used.

workflow.title: Inspect the site and agree on the scope
workflow.body: We itemise fault investigation, repairs and any proposed upgrades separately.

workflow.title: Schedule work around site access
workflow.body: We agree on when the work can take place and which areas it will affect.

workflow.title: Electrical testing and handover
workflow.body: We arrange for licensed electricians to check the affected circuits and equipment, then provide the work records.

faq.question: Can you repair a single light fitting or one area?
faq.answer: Yes. We distinguish a single fitting fault from a fault affecting a lighting zone before quoting on the relevant fittings, drivers or controls.

faq.question: Will lighting updates affect business operations?
faq.answer: We stage the work by circuit and area, agree on shutdown windows with you and identify which areas can remain in use at each stage.

faq.question: Can you install switches and power points during the same job?
faq.answer: Yes. We check equipment locations, the existing supply and power requirements before we specify the fittings and electrical work.

faq.question: How do you quote on a lighting upgrade?
faq.answer: We quote repairs and upgrades separately. We check fitting numbers, mounting height, controls and access and identify any areas that need to be taken out of use.

title: Plumbing, Drainage & Gas
heroCopy: We repair commercial plumbing leaks and blocked floor wastes or sinks and investigate hot water shortages. We itemise pipework, connections and equipment work and coordinate gas appliance work where applicable.

solution.heading: Commercial Drainage Blockage & Pipe Repairs
solution.inspection: We trace blockages from affected sinks and floor wastes through the connecting pipework. In food premises with recurring blockages, we check for grease or solids and identify the affected section.
solution.method: We clear the blockage and separately identify any pipe sections or damaged connections needing further investigation when it recurs.
solution.check: We test the drain and connections, then record the work and any follow-up needed.

solution.heading: Pipe and Joint Leak Repairs
solution.inspection: We trace signs of water back to valves and fixture connections and identify the pipe sections and areas that need checking.
solution.method: We scope the local pipe or joint repair and itemise any water shutdown and finish reinstatement needed afterwards.
solution.check: We test the connections in use and record where we carried out repairs and any follow-up needed.

problems.label: Insufficient hot water or fluctuating temperatures

solution.heading: Commercial Hot Water Equipment Maintenance & Upgrade
solution.inspection: We check the hot water unit, connections and available capacity against when peak use or temperature fluctuations occur.
solution.method: We itemise repairable components, any unit replacement and associated connection work, and agree when the system can be taken out of use.
solution.check: We test equipment operation and hot water performance, recording any repairs or replacements.

problems.label: Gas equipment connection and upgrade needs

solution.heading: Gas Equipment Connection & Upgrade
solution.inspection: We review the equipment, existing connections and installation conditions to define the scope of work.
solution.method: We scope connection or replacement work around the appliance and installation location and coordinate the appropriate trade and site access.
solution.check: We complete functional checks, recording connection and equipment work items.

faq.question: Can you investigate several slow drains at once?
faq.answer: Yes. We compare where drainage is slow or backing up, inspect the sinks, floor wastes and shared pipework, then scope clearing, pipe repairs or further checks.

faq.question: Will you need to turn off the water or shut down equipment?
faq.answer: Where water or equipment needs to be shut off, we identify the affected areas, agree the shutdown window and confirm reinstatement at handover.

faq.question: Can you inspect the hot water unit and its connections together?
faq.answer: Yes. We assess the unit, valves and connections against peak hot water demand and set out the repair, replacement and access requirements separately.

faq.question: Can you coordinate plumbing, drainage and equipment upgrades?
faq.answer: Yes. We look at how the systems connect and schedule the work around how you use the site.

title: HVAC and Building Systems
heroCopy: We service and repair commercial HVAC and building systems, including uneven temperatures, condensate leaks and shutdowns. We itemise inspection, cleaning, filters and repair work by unit.

problems.label: Poor heating or cooling, or uneven temperatures

solution.heading: Zone temperature and return‑air issues
solution.inspection: To trace poor cooling or uneven temperatures, we compare zones and operating times and check settings, supply and return air, filters and unit response.
solution.method: We itemise filter and airflow maintenance, control repairs and parts requiring replacement separately.
solution.check: After completion we check operating status, return‑air performance and condensate discharge, and record the work performed.

solution.heading: Condensate drain inspection and repairs
solution.inspection: We check the condensate tray, drain line and connections and compare the drip location with operating times to distinguish a drain leak from other water ingress.
solution.method: We clear confirmed blockages or repair faulty connections, recheck drainage and then coordinate reinstatement of the damp ceiling lining.
solution.check: We check drainage and equipment operation, recording the location of work and any follow‑up actions.

solution.heading: Investigating noise, vibration and shutdowns
solution.inspection: We compare when the noise, vibration or shutdown occurs with fan operation, equipment fixings and control response.
solution.method: Based on the inspection we adjust relevant components, repair or replace damaged items.
solution.check: We check equipment operation and response, compiling repair and replacement records.

problems.label: Dust on grilles, return‑air performance changes

solution.heading: Grille and return‑air component maintenance
solution.inspection: We inspect accessible filters, grilles and supply and return air components for dust, restrictions and signs that replacement is needed.
solution.method: We clean and maintain relevant components, identifying parts that need repair or replacement.
solution.check: We check return‑air performance and on-site cleaning, recording completed items.

items.body: We check that zone settings, timers and controls suit how the premises are used.

workflow.body: We check airflow, drainage and controls by unit and zone and separate servicing from fault repairs.

workflow.title: Operational checks and handover
workflow.body: We check how the equipment runs and record the completed work and any follow-up maintenance.

faq.question: Can you investigate hot and cold spots in the same building?
faq.answer: Yes. We check the affected zones, return air and operating schedules to find out why temperatures differ.

faq.question: Can you fix an air conditioning leak and the ceiling damage it caused?
faq.answer: We trace where the condensate is coming from and how it drains. Then we arrange the drainage repair and reinstate the affected ceiling in the right order.

faq.question: Can maintenance be scheduled around office or business hours?
faq.answer: We plan access around the equipment location and your operating hours, and tell you which areas the work will affect.

faq.question: Will the maintenance quote list filter cleaning, replacement and repairs?
faq.answer: Yes. We list inspections, cleaning and consumables by unit and set out filter replacement and fault repairs separately.

title: Fire, Security and Access Control
heroCopy: We coordinate maintenance for commercial access control, intercoms, CCTV and fire safety equipment. We scope reader, door and equipment faults by entry and system and hand over the findings.

problems.label: Card reader faults or difficulty gaining access

solution.heading: Access control and entry equipment maintenance
solution.inspection: We check door closing, the strike plate, reader response, power and access records to distinguish hardware faults from access control faults.
solution.method: We itemise repairs or replacements for the door, hardware and reader, retaining parts that still work.
solution.check: On completion we verify authorised access, door closing and system response, and record the adjustments made.

solution.heading: Commercial intercom maintenance
solution.inspection: We identify the entrance with poor audio, missing video or interrupted calls, then check its connections and power supply.
solution.method: We repair or replace components based on findings and resolve installation and connection issues.
solution.check: We test call, audio and video functions and record adjustments.

solution.heading: Security equipment and connection maintenance
solution.inspection: We compare entrances and common areas with the actual CCTV view and check camera position, coverage and connectivity.
solution.method: We address faulty components and connections, and adjust mounting positions to the confirmed coverage scope.
solution.check: We review equipment performance and compile adjustments and replacements.

solution.heading: Fire safety equipment maintenance
solution.inspection: We review the equipment locations, defects and existing records relevant to the job and scope the checks and work to be coordinated.
solution.method: We separate routine maintenance from recorded defects and coordinate the appropriate trades for the agreed work.
solution.check: We hand over a record by location of the equipment attended to, check results and defects still to be addressed.

faq.question: Can you investigate door closing and card reader faults at the same time?
faq.answer: Yes. We check the door, hardware and access controls together to find out whether the fault is mechanical or part of the access system.

faq.question: Can you update the access system when a tenancy changes hands?
faq.answer: We review how the new tenant will use the premises and work out which access equipment can stay, which needs adjusting and which needs replacing.

faq.question: How do you scope work on access control or fire safety equipment?
faq.answer: We review faults and existing maintenance records by device and location, then list checks, repairs and follow-up work separately.

faq.question: Do you record parts replaced and adjustments made?
faq.answer: We record repairs, parts and adjustments by entrance or device and hand over the results of the functional checks.

title: Commercial Landscaping and Irrigation
heroCopy: We maintain commercial entrances, car park planting and courtyards. We look after lawns, hedges and garden beds and repair leaking sprinklers and uneven irrigation.

solution.heading: Landscape edges and routine care
solution.inspection: We inspect lawns, kerbs, paved edges and areas where debris collects, then check pedestrian and vehicle access.
solution.method: We itemise mowing, edging, weed control and green waste clean-up by area, giving priority to entrances and busy paths.
solution.check: We check access space, garden edges and site clean-up, and record follow-up maintenance.

solution.heading: Shrub pruning and path clearance
solution.inspection: We identify growth affecting paths, sightlines at entrances and car park access and agree on the pruning scope.
solution.method: We prune within the agreed scope, remove cuttings and tidy adjacent areas.
solution.check: We check path clearance, pruning boundaries and site clean-up.

solution.heading: Sprinkler and irrigation repairs
solution.inspection: We compare dry and waterlogged areas by zone and check sprinklers, drip lines, controller settings and leaks.
solution.method: We repair damaged sprinklers or line connections and adjust irrigation to suit the planting in each zone.
solution.check: We recheck output, leaks and coverage in the zones repaired and record the repair locations.

solution.heading: Garden bed care and replacement planting
solution.inspection: We review the planting space, existing plants, boundaries and areas needing renewal.
solution.method: We remove weeds and green waste, tidy beds and replace planting within the agreed scope.
solution.check: We confirm completed areas and clean-up, and note follow-up maintenance.

faq.question: Can you maintain landscaping around commercial entrances and car parks?
faq.answer: We can maintain planting around entrances, paths, garden strips and car park boundaries, arranging work around site access.

faq.question: Can you refresh part of a garden bed or replace missing plants?
faq.answer: Yes. We inspect the bed and agree on what needs clearing, replanting or repair.

faq.question: Can you set up a regular grounds maintenance schedule?
faq.answer: Yes. We schedule lawns, hedges, garden beds and irrigation checks around seasonal growth and access, with an agreed scope for each visit.

title: Commercial Signage and Wayfinding
heroCopy: We repair and update shopfront signs, lightboxes, raised lettering and internal wayfinding. We check lighting, fixings and finishes, then itemise what can stay and what needs repair or replacement.

solution.heading: Shopfront and wayfinding updates
solution.inspection: We measure the shopfront sign and inspect its fixings, substrate and finish to identify parts that can be retained.
solution.method: We produce, install or update signs to the agreed layout and materials, including related fixings and finishes.
solution.check: We check the information, installation and site clean-up, and record completed work.

solution.heading: Lightbox and display maintenance
solution.inspection: We identify the unlit sections, check lighting components and connections, and assess whether the lightbox housing can stay.
solution.method: We split the lighting fault, cabinet and face repairs into separate items and arrange component repairs where the existing sign can stay.
solution.check: We check the display and installation and record the work.

solution.heading: Entrance and site wayfinding updates
solution.inspection: We review entrances, travel routes, existing information and destination areas.
solution.method: We produce or update wayfinding to the agreed wording and layout and install it in the corresponding locations.
solution.check: We confirm the information, direction and installation and organise completion photos.

problems.label: Loose signs or damaged surfaces and edges

solution.heading: Sign fixings and finish repairs
solution.inspection: We check accessible fixings, bases and adjoining finishes on loose signs and record ponding, corrosion and access height.
solution.method: We repair or replace damaged sections and address associated fixings and edges.
solution.check: We check the installation and appearance and record the repair scope.

title: Façade and High-Access Cleaning
heroCopy: We clean external glazing, frames, metal finishes and high canopies on commercial buildings. We scope the method, protection and work stages around materials, height and entrance access.

problems.label: Dusty glass and visible water marks

solution.heading: Glass and window frame cleaning
solution.inspection: We check glazing height, access points and build-up around the frames, distinguishing water marks on glass from residue on adjoining finishes.
solution.method: We clean to suit the surface, address dirt around edges and protect adjacent finishes.
solution.check: We check for water marks, residue around frames and any impact on adjoining finishes and record completion photos from the same locations.

solution.heading: Cleaning stains and rain streaks from façades
solution.inspection: We check the façade material, runoff marks and sheltered areas for trapped dirt, coating condition and visible joint damage.
solution.method: We select a cleaning method for the substrate and coating, trial it on a small area and then protect adjoining surfaces before working in sections.
solution.check: We check consistency, edges and residue and record any surface damage found.

solution.heading: Canopy and elevated surface cleaning
solution.inspection: We inspect the material and build-up on elevated canopies and check access and use of entrances or equipment below.
solution.method: We clean the agreed elevated sections, protecting related equipment and finishes.
solution.check: We recheck edges and residue and record the work area and issues found.

problems.label: Cleaning above an entrance affects access

solution.heading: Staged cleaning around entrances
solution.inspection: We review pedestrian routes, business hours and the work area above the entrance.
solution.method: We separate the work area from entrances and foot traffic and stage cleaning around trading and delivery times.
solution.check: We check completion and site clean-up and hand over access restoration and follow-up items.

faq.question: Will façade cracks and damage also be repaired?

faq.question: How do you quote for façade cleaning?

title: Commercial Cleaning and Environmental Care
heroCopy: We provide regular and one-off deep cleaning for offices, shopping centres and shared areas, including floors, carpets, bathrooms and bin rooms. We quote by area, task and frequency.

solution.heading: Deep cleaning for shared-area floors
solution.inspection: We assess floor materials, loose dirt, ingrained marks and traffic by area, then itemise sweeping and scrubbing where needed.
solution.method: We scope entrances, busy paths and edges separately and schedule sweeping and deep scrubbing by work zone.
solution.check: We check for residue and inspect edges before confirming that the area is ready to use again.

problems.label: Stains on sections of carpet or upholstery

solution.heading: Spot cleaning for carpet and upholstery
solution.inspection: We inspect carpet and upholstery materials, local staining and wear to identify which areas need attention.
solution.method: We select a method for the material and stain type, treating the affected and adjacent areas.
solution.check: We check the finish and any residue, then confirm when the area can reopen.

solution.heading: Commercial bathroom cleaning
solution.inspection: We check fixtures, partitions, floors and corners in commercial bathrooms and record limescale and build-up by area.
solution.method: We clean fixtures, partitions, floors and edges by area, then tidy the site.
solution.check: We check the completion list, edges and residue and note follow-up items.

problems.label: Dirty bin rooms and collection points

solution.heading: Bin room and collection point care
solution.inspection: We inspect the bin room floor, collection point and access path and distinguish staining and pooled residue from routine tidying.
solution.method: We tidy and clean bin rooms and collection points and agree on movement and handover around the property’s collection arrangements.
solution.check: We check the area and edges and organise the relevant records.

title: Car Parks and External Works
heroCopy: We repair potholes, line marking, bollards and wheel stops in commercial car parks and address blocked outlets and ponding. We stage the work around traffic lanes, bays and pedestrian routes.

solution.heading: Local car park surface repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect pavement around potholes and spalled edges and note any base or drainage issues needing a separate check.
solution.method: We itemise local pavement repairs, line marking reinstatement and finishes around fixtures by bay or traffic lane.
solution.check: We inspect the repaired surface and confirm when the area can reopen.

solution.heading: Car park markings and access area renewal
solution.inspection: We check the layout of bays and lanes and inspect existing line marking for wear and adhesion and assess the pavement beneath.
solution.method: We arrange cleaning, surface preparation and remarking to the agreed scope, managing work access in sections.
solution.check: We verify marking positions and completed areas and confirm when each zone can reopen based on surface condition and the site arrangements.

solution.heading: Bollard and wheel stop repairs
solution.inspection: We inspect bollards, wheel stops, anchors and surrounding concrete to distinguish fixture damage from problems at the fixing base.
solution.method: We repair or replace damaged fixtures and complete related fixing and surface work.
solution.check: We confirm positions, installation and clean-up and record the work.

solution.heading: Drain inlet repairs and ponding checks
solution.inspection: We inspect grates, accessible pits, outlets and adjoining pavement near ponding for blockages, damage or settlement.
solution.method: We clear confirmed outlet blockages and list any grate, pavement edge or connecting pipework that needs further work separately.
solution.check: We check treated areas and record completion and follow-up items.

title: Commercial Fit-outs and Make-good
heroCopy: We handle commercial refurbishment and end-of-lease make good. We itemise what to retain, strip out, repair, repaint or replace against the existing condition and agreed handover scope.

problems.label: Old partitions and fixtures to remove

solution.heading: Partition and fixed-fixture removal
solution.inspection: We compare the existing condition with the agreed make-good scope, marking partitions, joinery and fixtures to retain or strip out and noting connected services.
solution.method: We itemise protection of retained fixtures, strip-out and removal, then coordinate the affected services and trades.
solution.check: We check the removal list and clean-up and record subsequent repair areas.

problems.label: Wall and floor damage after removal

solution.heading: Wall and floor reinstatement after removal
solution.inspection: We inspect exposed fixing holes, damaged wall lining, floor edges and existing finishes after removal and confirm the required finish by area.
solution.method: We itemise local wall and floor repairs, repainting and finish replacement and coordinate the order of work.
solution.check: We check completion item by item, organise photos and note follow-up work.

solution.heading: Shopfront and commercial signage updates
solution.inspection: We review the shopfront, signs, fixings and finishes and identify retained and updated parts.
solution.method: We complete removal, sign updates and surface restoration within the agreed scope.
solution.check: We check information, installation and completed finishes.

solution.heading: Make-good work involving several trades
solution.inspection: We collate condition records and the handover list by location and identify strip-out, reinstatement and trade interfaces.
solution.method: We sequence protection, removal, repairs and finishes and record scope changes during the work.
solution.check: We hand over against the agreed retention, removal and reinstatement items, with completion photos and any outstanding work.
